meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复各类运行时故障，从崩溃到内存泄漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常遭遇崩溃、泄漏或莫名失败却难以定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix any runtime failure, from crashes to memory leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face crashes, leaks, or unexplained failures and can't find the root cause.

howto.what: 它会先查说明书确认运行环境,然后把每一步调试动作记在日志里,同时提出至少三个可能原因并逐一验证。找到真正原因后,先写一个会失败的测试来锁定问题,再做最小修改,最后实际运行确认修好,并删掉所有临时文件。
howto.when: 当你说「调试这个」「为什么 X 不工作」「卡住了」等,或要求排查崩溃、静默失败、内存泄漏,或提到 gdb、pwndbg 等调试器时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试一下,这个 Python 脚本一运行就崩溃。
say.note: 它会先读 Python 调试文档,再进入逐步排查。

say.text: 我的 Node 服务偶尔卡住不响应,查查原因。
say.note: 它会检查异步行为和事件循环,再做修复。

say.text: 这个测试本地能过,只在 CI 里失败,帮我查。
say.note: 它会先走 flaky-triage 流程缩小排查范围。

howto.what_en: It reads the runtime reference, journals artifacts, forms ≥3 hypotheses and investigates in parallel. It locks the root cause with a failing test, fixes minimally, verifies by actually running the system, then removes all artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on debug requests ('debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging'), on investigating crashes, silent failures, memory leaks, or when a debugger like gdb, pwndbg, lldb is mentioned.

say_en.text: Help me debug why this Python script crashes on run.
say_en.note: It reads the Python reference first, then starts the loop.

say_en.text: My Node service hangs sometimes and stops responding; find out why.
say_en.note: It checks async behavior and event loop, then fixes it.

say_en.text: This test only fails in CI but passes locally; investigate.
say_en.note: It starts with the flaky-triage flow to narrow it down.
